error_codes.name: InvalidArgument
doc: An argument is outside its documented range.

error_codes.name: Cancelled
doc: A callback asked to stop.

error_codes.name: Internal
doc: A bug inside teigeodata (a panic caught at the boundary, or a broken invariant).

error_codes.name: Io
doc: A file could not be read.

error_codes.name: Corrupt
doc: The bytes are not a valid pack, or a section does not match its hash.

error_codes.name: MissingComponent
doc: The query needs a component of a pack that is not installed: install it, or ask a
pack that has it.

constants.name: SAMPLE_ROWS_MAX
doc: Most rows `sample_rows` builds in one call.

constants.name: LIMIT_MAX
doc: Most places one query returns.

functions.name: version
doc: The library version, from its package metadata.

functions.name: noop
doc: Does nothing. Measures the bare cost of a call across each boundary.

functions.name: fold
doc: The search fold of a name: NFKD, lower case, optional accents dropped by script, spaces
collapsed, recomposed to NFC. The same fold the forge and the search index use.

functions.name: sample_rows
doc: Builds `rows` deterministic sample places as a blob with the columns `id` (`u32`), `lat`
and `lon` (`f64`, degrees), `elevation` (`f32`, metres) and `name` (UTF-8). Exercises the
result path of every binding.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `rows` exceeds `SAMPLE_ROWS_MAX`.

functions.name: progress
doc: Calls `on_step` once per step with the step number, from 1 to `steps`, on the calling
thread, and returns the number of steps run. Exercises callbacks in every binding.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::Cancelled` if `on_step` returns `false`.

functions.name: distance_m
doc: Great-circle distance in metres between two points in degrees, by the haversine formula on
the WGS84 mean sphere (error up to about 0.5% against the ellipsoid).
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if a latitude is outside -90..=90, a longitude outside
-180..=180, or any value is not finite.

handles.name: Engine
doc: Open packs answering place queries (D-141, D-274). Every method takes `&self`: one engine
answers from any number of threads at once, and adding a pack publishes a new snapshot
while queries go on.
Place results are blobs with the columns `id`, `name`, `kind`, `level`, `lat`, `lon`,
`elevation`, `parent`, `tz` and `iso` (absent values are null), plus `score` for a search
and `meters` and `bearing` for a reverse lookup.

methods.name: new
doc: An engine with no packs.

methods.name: open_file
doc: Opens the pack at `path` (memory-mapped) and adds it. Returns its layer ID, for
`remove`: unique in this engine, counting up from 0.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::Io` if the file cannot be read, `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if it is not a
valid pack.

methods.name: open_file_with
doc: Opens the pack at `path` with these options and adds it. Returns its layer ID, as
`open_file`.
# Errors
As `open_file`, and `ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for an outline
level above 255.

methods.name: open_bytes
doc: Adds a pack from its bytes (copied). Returns its layer ID, as
`open_file`.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if the bytes are not a valid pack.

methods.name: open_bytes_with
doc: Adds a pack from its bytes (copied) with these options. Returns its layer ID, as
`open_file`.
# Errors
As `open_bytes`, and `ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for an outline
level above 255.

methods.name: remove
doc: Removes the pack with this layer ID; false if no pack has it. Queries already running
finish on the snapshot they started with; the pack's memory is released after them.

methods.name: layers
doc: The number of packs.

methods.name: get
doc: The place with this ID (`tgd:np/1`), or no row; a retired ID gives its survivor.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `id` is not a place ID; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: parent
doc: The place's parent as the packs answer for it (one row), or no row for a root or an
unknown ID.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `id` is not a place ID; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: ancestors
doc: The place's ancestors, parent first up to the country; no rows for a root or an
unknown ID.
# Errors
As `parent`.

methods.name: children
doc: The place's children, by ID; no rows for a leaf or an unknown ID.
# Errors
As `parent`.

methods.name: nearby
doc: The places nearest the place with this ID, not counting it, nearest first, at most
`limit`, with `meters` and `bearing`; no rows for an unknown ID.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `id` is not a place ID or `limit` exceeds
`LIMIT_MAX`; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: search
doc: Places matching `query`, best first, at most `limit`; "Name, Parent" ranks a named
parent first. The `score` column compares only within one query.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `limit` exceeds `LIMIT_MAX`;
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: search_with
doc: `search` ranked by `options`: near a focus point, or in strict match
order.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `limit` exceeds `LIMIT_MAX`, the focus is off the
globe or has one coordinate only, or its scale is not positive;
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: reverse
doc: The places nearest the point, nearest first, at most `limit`, with `meters` and
`bearing` (degrees from north) to each.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe or a `limit` above
`LIMIT_MAX`; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: within_radius
doc: The places within `meters` of the point (great-circle), nearest first, at most `limit`,
with `meters` and `bearing` to each.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe, a negative or non-finite
radius, or a `limit` above `LIMIT_MAX`; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is
corrupt.

methods.name: admin_at
doc: The admin units holding the point, country first.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: elevation_at
doc: The terrain height at the point, as one row: `meters` above the datum (bilinear between
the DEM samples around it), `source` (the DEM product's key, null where the pack does
not state it), `resolution_m` (the sample spacing north to south) and `datum`
(`EGM2008`). No row where no pack has terrain there (the sea, outside every grid).
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
grid read is corrupt.

methods.name: postal_lookup
doc: The places postal code `code` names, one row per code and place, with the code's
`postal`, `scheme`, `code_kind`, `valid_from` and `valid_to` columns. `scheme` names
one scheme (`np`, `gb`); empty means every scheme whose rule accepts the input. The
code may be typed with or without separators, in any case, or in another script's
digits. Retired codes are returned too, with their validity.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: postal_prefix
doc: Up to `limit` postal codes starting with `input`, with their places (autocomplete),
in code order per scheme; `scheme` as in `postal_lookup`.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `limit` exceeds `LIMIT_MAX`;
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

methods.name: postal_codes_of
doc: The postal codes of the place with this ID; no rows for an unknown ID.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `id` is not a place ID; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: postal_at
doc: The postal codes of the point: those of the deepest admin unit holding it that an
admin-aligned scheme gives codes to, with its parts (a ward's code; the point is in one
of them). No rows where no unit holding the point has such codes.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: tz_at
doc: The time-zone area holding the point (one row; its `tz` column is the IANA zone), or no
row where no pack answers.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` for a point off the globe; `ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a
section read is corrupt.

methods.name: by_iso
doc: The place whose ISO 3166 code is `code` (`NP`, `NP-P3`, either case), or no row.
# Errors
`ErrorCode::InvalidArgument` if `code` is not an ISO 3166 code;
`ErrorCode::Corrupt` if a section read is corrupt.

records.name: SearchOptions
doc: How `Engine::search_with` ranks (D-226). Every field's zero value is its default

fields.name: focus_lat
doc: Prefer places near this latitude (with `focus_lon`): the user's location, or a point
in their home country with a wide scale.

fields.name: focus_lon
doc: The focus longitude; set with `focus_lat` or not at all.

fields.name: focus_scale_m
doc: The distance in metres at which the focus gain halves (a place at the focus gains 30,
one scale away 15); `None` is 50 km.

fields.name: strict
doc: Rank by match tier first (exact, loose, prefix, one edit, substring, two edits,
phonetic), then importance and focus, instead of one additive score.

records.name: OpenOptions
doc: How `Engine::open_file_with` and `Engine::open_bytes_with` open a pack. Every field's
zero value is its default (D-276).

fields.name: priority
doc: Precedence over the other packs: a higher one wins where packs disagree (default 0).

fields.name: verify
doc: When sections are verified.

fields.name: load
doc: How a file is loaded; ignored for bytes.

fields.name: outline_level
doc: The deepest admin level whose outlines are read, in a pack that splits its outlines by
level: admin units below it are not found at a point, and their outlines are not
loaded. `None` reads every level.

fields.name: outline_tolerance_m
doc: The largest simplification of the outlines read, in metres, when the pack has coarser
outlines; 0 is full resolution. Admin units at a point may then differ within that
distance of a border.

fields.name: components
doc: The components the pack holds, by name and comma-separated (`point,names,search`), for
a pack installed in part; what they need is added. Empty for a whole pack. A query
that needs a component left out answers nothing, or `MissingComponent` where it cannot.

fields.name: languages
doc: The languages whose names and search sections are read, as comma-separated BCP 47
tags (`en,ne`), at most 8; a language without a part of its own reads the pack's
shared part. Empty reads every language.

enums.name: Verify
doc: When a pack's sections are verified against their hashes.

variants.name: Lazy
doc: On first use: each section, or each 16 KiB block of a large one, is checked the first
time a query reads it. Opening costs only the head checks.

variants.name: Eager
doc: Every section when the pack opens.

variants.name: Trusted
doc: Never: only for bytes already verified, by the store's installer for instance.

enums.name: Load
doc: How a pack file is loaded.

variants.name: Map
doc: Map the file into memory where the platform can, read it otherwise. The file must not
be written over while it is open.

variants.name: Read
doc: Read the whole file into memory: for files the application does not own.
